title: VillagerMoveIn
description: Allows villagers of villages you've found to join the wandering trader on a visit to you.
body:
Tired of moving villagers back home you have found on your journey? Let them join the wandering merchant, leading them right to you!

# What is VillagerMoveIn?
VillagerMoveIn allows you to take on your everyday journey and discover villages of different biomes without the hassle of moving them to your own home. VillagerMoveIn keeps track of the different villages you have discovered and sometimes spawns a villager of those villages alongside of the wandering merchant.
